Messages.Author: Boon Sian Chang
Messages.Body:
In general, should VTES cards take precedence over the old Jyhad
cards? For instance, Tragic Love Affair needs a Toreador to play
in the VTES version, but the Jyhad version does not. Similarly,
Jyhad Asylum Hunting Grounds requires no blood to play, but VTES
version requires it.

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
Boon Sian Chang (bsc...@acs3.acs.ucalgary.ca) wrote:
: In general, should VTES cards take precedence over the old Jyhad


In general, yes.

But, in the cases you cite, errata exists to fix the differences,
which were just typos and/or printing errors:

Tragic Love Affair (VtES) has errata that it does not require a
ready Toreador to play.

Asylum Hunting Grounds (Jyhad) has a two pool cost.
It is the VtES version that is mis-printed, and it has errata to
have the two pool cost.

--
